user.title: Midea Cloud Control
user.description: Sign in with the app account your air conditioner is registered to. This is used to relay commands through the vendor cloud, so no device token is required.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check the email, password, and that the selected app matches the one your appliance is registered in.
error.no_appliances: Login succeeded but no appliances were found on this account.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.
